units.source_text: 此后有一时期，源氏公子一直住在左大臣邸内。

en.t: After this, Prince Genji lived for a time at the residence of the Minister of the Left.

units.source_text: 他想起今后和空蝉音信断绝，薄倖名成，心中痛苦不堪，

en.t: When he thought that from now on all word from Utsusemi would be cut off, and that he would be known as unlucky in love, his heart ached unbearably,

units.source_text: 便召唤纪伊守前来，对他说：

en.t: so he summoned the Governor of Kii and said to him:

units.source_text: “能不能把前回看到的卫门督的小君给我呢？

en.t: Could you give me the young son of the Captain of the Gate Guards whom I saw last time?

units.source_text: 我觉得这孩子可爱，想教他到我身边来，

en.t: I find the child charming and would like to have him come to my side,

units.source_text: 由我推荐给皇上当殿上侍童。”

en.t: and I would recommend him to His Majesty as a page in palace service.

units.source_text: 纪伊守答道：

en.t: The Governor of Kii replied:

units.source_text: “多蒙照拂，实深感激。

en.t: I am deeply grateful for your generous favor.

units.source_text: 我当把此意转告他姐姐去。”

en.t: I shall convey your wishes to his elder sister.

units.source_text: 源氏公子听到姐姐两字，心中别的一跳。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard the words elder sister, his heart gave a sudden different leap.

units.source_text: 便问：

en.t: He then asked:

units.source_text: “这姐姐有没有生下你的弟弟来？”

en.t: Has this elder sister borne a younger brother of yours?

units.source_text: “没有。

en.t: No, she has not.

units.source_text: 她嫁给我父亲还只两年。

en.t: It has only been two years since she married my father.

units.source_text: 她父亲卫门督指望她入宫，

en.t: Her father, the Captain of the Gate Guards, had hoped she would enter palace service,

units.source_text: 她违背了遗言，不免后悔。

en.t: and since she went against his dying wish, she cannot help regretting it.

units.source_text: 听说对现在这境遇很不满意呢。”

en.t: I hear she is very dissatisfied with her present circumstances.

units.source_text: “那是很可怜的了。

en.t: That is truly pitiable.

units.source_text: 外间传说她是个才貌双全的美人，实际上如何？”

en.t: People say she is a beauty blessed with both talent and looks; what is she really like?

units.source_text: 纪伊守答道：

en.t: The Governor of Kii answered:

units.source_text: “相貌并不坏。

en.t: Her appearance is certainly not bad.

units.source_text: 不过我同她疏远，知道的不详。

en.t: But I am not close to her, so I do not know the details.

units.source_text: 照世间的常规，对后母是不便亲近的。”

en.t: By the usual ways of the world, it is not easy to be intimate with a stepmother.
